correctness.rationale: For G=K_n∘K_1, signed graph-distance KR norm equals sum |leaf masses| + 1/2 sum |collapsed core masses|, by forced pendant flows and complete-core direct transport. Edge-difference heat vectors decompose into trivial and index-mean-zero two-by-two blocks, leading to exact two edge-type transport costs E_n=r_n+(3-n)q_n and P_n=(n-1)/n(2r_n+(n-2)q_n)-(n-2)/n e^-2t. For t>0 E_2>P_2; n>=3 P_n>E_n from explicit positive difference. Equality along nonzero spanning-tree flow edges determines extremal 1-Lipschitz potentials (ramp when n=2, n rays otherwise). A strictly decreasing derivative sign bracket has initial n-3, so n=3 decreases, n>=4 unique positive peak. Exact coefficient inequalities give strictly Λ<2 for every finite n,t while at t=log(n)/n, P_n→2. Time t=0 every nonconstant f extremizes. Boundary parameters and normalization stated.
